import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import pytest

FF = Path('C:/Users/郑曾波/Projects/filing-fetch')
sys.path.insert(0,str(FF/'scripts'))
import transcript_tool_transport as transport_owner


@pytest.fixture
def harness(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
    tool=tmp_path/'offline_tool.py'
    tool.write_text('# never executes; pure boundary injection')
    owner=transport_owner.EarningsTranscriptsTransport(wiki_root=tmp_path,transcript_tool=tool,deadline=1000)
    monkeypatch.setattr(owner,'_et_environment',lambda:({},None))
    return owner


@pytest.mark.parametrize('limit,remaining,seconds,outer',[
    (120.9,181.2,120,123),(120.9,100.4,97,100),(10.01,13.99,10,13)])
def test_nonround_explicit_allocation_and_real_parent_remaining(harness,monkeypatch,limit,remaining,seconds,outer):
    monkeypatch.setattr(harness,'_remaining',lambda:remaining)
    seen=[]
    def run(command,*,input_bytes,timeout_seconds,**kwargs):
        seen.append((json.loads(input_bytes),timeout_seconds))
        usage={'schema_version':'earnings-retrieval-usage/1','request_id':'independent',
          'usage_complete':True,'usage':{'requests_used':7,'response_bytes_used':50000001}}
        return b'{"status":"content_too_large","error_code":"byte_limit"}',json.dumps(usage).encode(),2
    monkeypatch.setattr(transport_owner,'_run_bounded_json',run)
    result=harness._et_result(request={'request_id':'independent','security_id':'SYNTHETIC','exchange':'NYSE',
      'fiscal_year':2025,'fiscal_quarter':4,'as_of_date':'2026-11-01'},
      limits={'timeout_seconds':limit,'max_bytes':21000001,'max_cost_usd':'0.25'})
    assert len(seen)==1
    wire,timeout=seen[0]
    assert wire['timeout_seconds']==seconds and timeout==outer
    assert wire['max_body_bytes']==wire['max_response_bytes']==21000001
    assert wire['max_cost_usd']=='0.25' and wire['exchange']=='nyse'
    assert result['provider_requests']==7 and result['provider_response_bytes']==50000001
    assert result['provider_usage_complete'] is True and result['retryable'] is False


def test_parent_deadline_can_shrink_between_wire_and_actual_launch(harness,monkeypatch):
    remaining=iter([180.0,5.25])
    monkeypatch.setattr(harness,'_remaining',lambda:next(remaining))
    observed=[]
    def run(command,*,input_bytes,timeout_seconds,**kwargs):
        observed.append((json.loads(input_bytes),timeout_seconds))
        raise transport_owner.TransportError('synthetic child transport failure')
    monkeypatch.setattr(transport_owner,'_run_bounded_json',run)
    result=harness._et_result(request={'request_id':'independent','security_id':'SYNTHETIC','exchange':'NYSE',
      'fiscal_year':2025,'fiscal_quarter':4,'as_of_date':'2026-11-01'},
      limits={'timeout_seconds':120,'max_bytes':21000001,'max_cost_usd':'0.25'})
    assert len(observed)==1 and observed[0][0]['timeout_seconds']==120 and observed[0][1]==5.25
    assert result['provider_usage_complete'] is False
    assert result['provider_requests'] is None and result['provider_response_bytes'] is None
    assert result['provider_calls']==1 and result['retryable'] is False
